abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Cardivel lowers systolic drop compared with Standard care. Overall, Brostamide improves systolic drop compared with Standard care.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Cardivel lowers systolic drop compared with Standard care. Overall, Brostamide improves systolic drop compared with Standard care.
section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Willow Lane Cohort.

Table 4. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Systolic drop | 12.7 | 6.3 | 500 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Cardivel | Systolic drop | 10.0 | 5.0 | 500 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 16.8 | 8.4 | 500 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Systolic drop | 13.3 | 6.7 | 500 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Cardivel | Systolic drop | 10.7 | 5.3 | 500 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 15.7 | 7.8 | 500 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
